🇵🇭 A ferry has sunk off the coast of the Philippines: 18 dead, dozens missing

The ferry capsized near Pilas Island on the night of January 26. The cause of the accident is under investigation. According to survivors, the sea was calm at the time of the incident.

A total of 317 people were rescued. Twenty-four people are still reported missing.
